Lobster quota talks stall as prices fall

By Marcus Bell · {{DATE_MINUS_10}} · Business

Talks between the province's processors and the fishermen's association on next season's lobster prices ended without agreement on Friday. The shore price has fallen from $9.50 a pound two years ago to $6.75 this spring.

The association says fuel and bait costs have risen a third in the same period. Processors point to weaker demand in Asia and a stronger Canadian dollar. Both sides meet again next month.
